# Third-Party ACM Sources

The unmodified `acmart.cls` and `ACM-Reference-Format.bst` came from the official ACM small-format Overleaf template opened for this assignment on 28 September 2026. The class identifies itself as version 2.19, dated 2026/06/27. Its documented source is included here as required by its distribution notice.

- `acmart.dtx`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/borisveytsman/acmart/v2.19/acmart.dtx
- `samples.dtx`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/borisveytsman/acmart/v2.19/samples/samples.dtx
- Template: https://www.overleaf.com/latex/templates/association-for-computing-machinery-acm-small-standard-format-template/sksvmbxyfhnw

The ACM class and sample sources retain their LaTeX Project Public License notices. The bibliography style identifies its license as public domain in its header. These third-party terms do not license the student's original manuscript, diagrams, or repository documentation, which remain unlicensed.

`Evidence/Original_ACM_Template_Source.zip` preserves the downloaded template files before manuscript upload. It is historical evidence, not the final paper source ZIP.
